turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello! How have you been lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I still haven't got anything for my dad and the holidays are in two weeks.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Still time. Does he like gadgets, or would something like a nice sweater or a cooking class feel more like him?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a second, my brother needs help with something. Stay quiet until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Priya, which microphone did you buy for your show?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A cheap USB one. It's honestly fine for talking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Does it pick up a lot of background noise?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: A bit. I record in the closet now, the clothes soak up the echo.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's cramped though. You learn to sit very still.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you remember the wifi password?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, I'm back. Sorry about that.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Any closer to knowing what your dad would like, a gadget or something else?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably a gadget, he loves anything with buttons.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Easy then. A wireless meat thermometer is a fun one for a dad who grills.
